title: Authoring-evidence sidecar — prose evidence behind hand-authored containers (S4.6a, s4_plan 1.4.1)
description: Tier-1 shape validation only: field presence, types, and no extra keys (additionalProperties:false throughout). Everything the shape cannot say is the gate's (assert_evidence_gate over evidence_findings): digest staleness, the one-entry-per-human-container correspondence, and orphan/misbound binding. The staleness key is SPLIT (1.4.1b, post-audit remediation 2026-07-02): decision_digest pins the human's topology decision (node_class + ordered children node ids — never machine-refreshed), extent_digest pins the substrate binding (slot-aware since the F5/Option B closure 2026-07-02: the node's own per-slot binding plus the beneath-union — mechanically re-stampable at S5 where a re-bind is unique and above threshold). Both are produced only by the engine producers (decision_digest / extent_digest via build_evidence_entry) — never hand-computed. Beside each digest the entry persists its PAYLOAD WITNESS (DT-4 of the S4.6b tooling plan, user-ratified 2026-07-02): the exact payload the digest hashes — decision_payload verbatim, extent_payload with each sorted atom-id list run-length encoded ([first, last] pairs). Witnesses are explanation data, never attestation: the loader self-verifies each against its digest (a mismatch is a load failure naming the node), and the digest-diff explainer diffs them against the live producers to name WHICH children/atoms moved. authored_at_revision is informational bookkeeping (the map_revision current when the entry was written); it is NEVER a staleness trigger. schema_version const is bound to the live AUTHORING_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION by evidence_schema_version_const() + the version-derived conforming fixture; stale_class is the persisted M3 layer discriminator; book binds the sidecar to its workspace.

schema_version.description: The sidecar document schema version. Bound to AUTHORING_EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION via evidence_schema_version_const() — a bump here without the Python constant (or vice versa) fails the binding test.

stale_class.description: The M3 layer discriminator, persisted in the document like every governed layer's envelope. Bound to AUTHORING_EVIDENCE_STALE_CLASS; the loader pre-checks it so a foreign artifact under this filename reads as a routing failure, not a shape failure.

book.description: The book id this sidecar documents. The loader's expected_book check makes a structurally valid sidecar from another book a loud load failure (wrong artifact), not a confusing gate result. Whitespace-only is rejected at the typed build — minLength cannot see it.

entries.description: One entry per hand-authored container, keyed by node_id (duplicates are rejected at the typed build — a keyed table cannot hold two). May be empty: the sidecar is optional at generic load (1.4.1a); coverage is demanded by the S4.6 gate, not the shape.

node_id.description: The bound node's opaque id. Resolution against the live map is the gate's (orphaned/misbound findings), not the shape's.

decision_digest.description: The 1.4.1b decision digest of the bound node at authoring time: node_class + ordered children node ids, nothing else. Re-bind-stable; a drift means a human changed the map's shape (gate finding kind stale-decision) and is never machine-refreshed.

extent_digest.description: The 1.4.1b extent digest of the bound node at authoring time — slot-aware (F5/Option B closure, 2026-07-02): the node's own per-slot binding (each slot a sorted set) plus the flat sorted union of all descendant coverage. A drift means the node's own binding or its spanned substrate changed (gate finding kind stale-extent); mechanically re-stampable at S5 under a unique, above-threshold re-bind.

evidence.description: The prose rationale for this container (scan-grounded authoring evidence). Whitespace/zero-width-only prose is rejected at the typed build — minLength cannot see it.

authored_at_revision.description: The map_revision current when this entry was authored. Bookkeeping only (1.4.1b) — never consulted by the staleness check.

atom_run_list.description: A sorted atom-id list in witness wire form: each item is a plain id or a two-element [first, last] inclusive run (shared prefix, equal-width decimal tails). Decode validity, ascending order, and the run-expansion ceiling are the typed build's; digest coherence is the entry model's.

decision_payload.description: The DT-4 witness of decision_digest, stored verbatim (children order is meaningful — never sorted, never run-encoded). Self-verified against the digest at load.

extent_payload.description: The DT-4 witness of extent_digest: the node's own per-slot binding plus the beneath union, each list run-encoded on the wire. Self-verified against the digest at load. own carries heading+signature (container) or body (leaf) — exactly the producer shapes; the exact-shape rule is the typed build's (oneOf here would mask WHICH slot is wrong).
